title: Idempotence of the code projection
statement: Let $C$ be a closed subspace of the $n$-qubit Hilbert space $\mathcal{H}_n = \ell^2(\{0,1\}^n, \bbc)$, and let $P_C : \mathcal{H}_n \to \mathcal{H}_n$ be the orthogonal projection onto $C$. Then $P_C$ is idempotent: for every $x \in \mathcal{H}_n$, \[ P_C(P_C\, x) = P_C\, x. \]
hypotheses_covered: C is a subspace of the n-qubit Hilbert space
x ranges over all of H_n
replaced: The code projection is idempotent: $P_C(P_C\,x) = P_C\,x$ for all $x \in \mathcal{H}_n$.
